call_mcp_tool: call a specific MCP tool by name with arguments and return the execution result
list_mcp_tools: list all available MCP tools from configured MCP servers for the authenticated user
list_mcp_prompts: list all available MCP prompts from configured MCP servers for the authenticated user
list_mcp_resources: list all available MCP resources from configured MCP servers for the authenticated user
read_mcp_resource: read resource contents from an MCP server given a resource URL
